# The Dragon Tyranny — Narrative Script

*Audio: 14_The_Dragon_Tyranny.mp3 — August 2, 2026*

---

For six thousand years after the crash, the world belonged to the dragons.

Twelve clans ruled ninety percent of the known land. They were not gods — but they were the closest thing Ge'or had ever seen. Spaceborn, ancient, their hoarding instinct was a survival drive left over from a time when attracting metallic asteroids meant shelter from radiation. Now it meant treasure. Now it meant dominion.

The dragon empires bred servants for their cities. War wolves — larger, more intelligent than the wild wargs, loyal beyond death — patrolled the streets of Klobiendar and Xi, enforcing order without a handler. The age before Baoth was an age of wings, of fire, of cities built to please beings who thought in millennia.

But the clans fought. The death wars consumed them — twelve dynasties tearing each other apart for supremacy. The final war ended in the capital of Klobiendar, where Melberior of Xi launched a suicide spell so immense it pulled the black agent from the atmosphere, saturating the corpses of dragons with a power that would not let them die.

The dragon empires fell. The war wolves scattered. The world entered a new age — an age of stone and steel, of dwarves, of underground megacities fueled by Romanium ore.

The Age of Dragons was over. The Dwarf Era had begun.
